cause.root_cause_summary: A readiness label recurring across independently-generated phases (real PHASE-S18, then PHASE-SSI-S27, both saying SELF_IMPROVING_STUDIO_FOUNDATION_READY) looks, on the surface, like a standing instruction to build -- but the label only ever meant "conditions for founding are met," and PHASE-SSI-S0 already acted on exactly that meaning once; re-triggering construction on seeing the same label a second time would have been building from the label's surface text instead of from what the repository actually shows.

lesson: A recurring readiness label is not itself evidence that something is still missing -- checking whether the label has already been acted on (here, by finding PHASE-SSI-S0's foundation model and confirming it explicitly cites real PHASE-S18's own judgment as its input) has to happen before any new construction, exactly as this phase's own core instruction required: confirm the real gap before building the structure, not after.
